% A test for tex8web: a document in newtx's Times, whose fonts tex4ht names
% after their files (ntx-Italic-tlf-t1), and TeX Gyre's Heros for its
% sans-serif, which the page is set in.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{newtxtext}
\begin{document}
Text in Times, \emph{in italics}, \textbf{in bold} and \textsf{in Heros}.
\end{document}
